system.description:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a living adversary within Far range. On a success, spend any number of Hope to issue as many orders:

  • If you cause the target to move, they move to a location you choose that’s within Close range of them.
  • If you cause the target to attack, make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Melee range of them. On a success, deals its weapon damage.
  • If you cause the target to do anything else, it does so to the best of its ability.

Whenever you issue an order that is against the target's nature, they may mark a Stress to immediately end the effect. The effect otherwise ends if the puppet is no longer in your line of sight.
